act.long_title: An Act to provide a general Penal Code for India.

section.heading: Abetment of act of insubordination by soldier, sailor or airman
section.html: Whoever abets what he knows to be an act of insubordination by an officer, soldier, [sailor or airman], in the Army, [Navy or air Force], of the [Government of India], shall, if such act of insubordination be committed in consequence of that abetment, be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to six months, or with fine, or with both.
